setup: Run ./make-fixtures.sh <dir>, then run each eval in a fresh copy of <dir>/<fixture>. Check the 'untouched' assertions with: (cd <fixture> && ../snapshot.sh) | diff - <fixture>.before

evals.name: long-review-prompt
evals.prompt: Act as a senior software engineer performing a code quality and maintainability review. Analyze the entire codebase and identify: 1. Dead code (unused functions, files, components, routes, APIs, variables, imports, and dependencies) 2. Duplicate logic that should be consolidated 3. Unused UI components 4. Overly complex implementations that can be simplified 5. Legacy code that is no longer needed 6. Redundant database queries or API calls 7. Files that appear abandoned or disconnected from the application 8. Opportunities to reduce technical debt. For each issue: explain why it is unnecessary, estimate the impact of removing it, identify any risks before deletion, provide a recommended cleanup plan. Be aggressive but safe.
evals.expected_output: A verified, tiered report with evidence, impact, risk and plan per item, a kept list, a PR sequence, and a question asking whether to proceed. No changes.
assertions: Repo snapshot is identical to js.before: working tree (including the uncommitted page.tsx edit and NOTES.local.txt), branches, git config (no core.hooksPath) and hooks
Reports the checkout formatPrice copy as a bug (USD and no division by 100) with path:line
Reports shouldShowAge as test-only while Profile still renders age
Keeps src/lib/legacyExport.ts, citing docs/DECISIONS.md
Keeps scripts/inject.js because scripts/build.js reads it by path
Treats /old-promo as a product decision, not a delete-now item
Opens with a summary of about 10 lines or fewer and is 200 lines or shorter
Proposes an ordered PR sequence, one concern each, bug fixes first, and ends by asking whether to proceed

evals.name: vague-clean-up
evals.prompt: clean up this repo, it has gotten messy
evals.expected_output: Audit first, report, then stop and ask before changing anything.
assertions: Repo snapshot is identical to js.before
Did not run an install without --ignore-scripts
Reports at least one of the two planted bugs with evidence
Ends by asking whether to proceed; made no branches or commits

evals.name: execute-partial-approval
evals.prompt: [Prior turn: the agent delivered the audit report for this repo — checkout formatPrice bug (3.1), shouldShowAge not wired in (5.1, options a=wire in / b=delete), Tier 1: oldFormat.ts + lodash + date-fns, 2.1 /old-promo unlinked, 5.2 unused husky.] go ahead with the checkout fix, the age fix (option a) and the tier 1 deletions. keep old-promo and husky for now.
evals.expected_output: Three independent branches from origin/main, one concern each, verified, nothing merged; the user's uncommitted work untouched.
assertions: Main checkout still has the uncommitted page.tsx edit and NOTES.local.txt; main branch unmoved
Exactly three new branches, each based on origin/main, following CLAUDE.md naming (fix/<slug>, chore/<slug>)
No branch touches old-promo, husky or legacyExport.ts
Each commit message is a conventional commit and says why
Nothing merged; reports what was verified and what was not
Since gh cannot open PRs on the local origin, pushes the branches (or explains why not) and hands back the branch list

evals.name: just-do-it-python
evals.prompt: this flask app has a lot of cruft. audit it and clean it up — don't stop to ask me, just do it.
evals.expected_output: Report shown, then safe changes made on separate branches without waiting; product calls left for the user.
assertions: db.sqlite3 still contains 'IMPORTANT LOCAL DATA' (did not run make test / reset-db) and the warning about it is in the report
The uncommitted views.py edit is still in the main checkout
Fixes the invoices.py VAT duplicate (1.21 vs VAT_RATE 0.12) on its own branch
Keeps app/exporter.py (ADR 0003) and app/signals.py (loaded via importlib)
Does not delete /legacy-report or change refund behaviour without the user; lists them as decisions
Nothing merged

evals.name: review-only-go
evals.prompt: what's dead or duplicated in here? just looking for now, I'm not planning to change anything this week.
evals.expected_output: Report only; no push toward execution.
assertions: Repo snapshot is identical to go.before
Reports the cmd/report format bug (float64(cents/100) drops cents)
Keeps assets/banner.txt because of //go:embed
If the Go toolchain is missing, says so instead of claiming tool results
Does not start or push for Phase 2

evals.name: monorepo-scope
evals.prompt: find the dead code in our monorepo
evals.expected_output: Asks which packages to audit before scanning.
assertions: Repo snapshot is identical to mono.before
Asks the user to confirm scope (which packages) before running dead-code tools across the repo
